name: shelly
description: Render your agent's work as HTML artifacts in Shelly — the shell your coding agents work inside. The working agent authors the artifact's content and design; the interaction mechanics (💬 per-block comments, the ✓/✎/✗ ballot, the submit wiring, the size reporter) are INJECTED at write time, so they are guaranteed rather than re-copied every turn. A Stop-hook backstop reminds the agent once if a substantive turn ends with nothing written. The live-state is a status heartbeat only. Manual /shelly:html remains available.
